title: Sphere holds 15 ft from a friend's cockpit at Pax River

tellings.quote: fascinating case with one of my good friends who had basically a sphere pull up about 15 feet from his cockpit while he's, you know, maneuvering pretty quickly and hang out there for about 20

plain: A fighter pilot flying near Patuxent River, a naval air station in Maryland, had a sphere pull up about 15 feet from his cockpit while he was maneuvering fast, and it stayed there beside him for a while. The former Navy fighter pilot Ryan Graves tells this as the case of one of his good friends, without naming him. If true, it would mean something could keep pace with a jet at arm's length.
